fix.delta: det-metadata-extraction: sov6-logic-v3-light and sov6-synthesis-v3-light both return 100% unparsed responses on the DetBench bank — this is a format/transport failure, not a true-zero on detection capability. The 33/33 unparsed suggests the model responses are valid JSON but the expected keys differ from what the DetBench parser expects. Fix candidate: add a DetBench format adapter that maps sovos-engine model output keys (reasoning, verdict, confidence) to DetBench expected keys (detection_result, detection_confidence, detection_rationale). Also add a pre-parse normalisation step that strips markdown code fences from model output before JSON parsing — deepseek-r1:8b has 1 unparsed out of 33, which is likely a stray backtick. This is a measurement-system fix, not a model-capability fix — the engine should not report 0.000 when the model is producing structured output in an unexpected shape.
